scope: Synthetic measurement-extension canary only; not a pilot annotation or an independent episode.
payload_boundary: Before any canary call, supply the exact response text as a top-level annotation payload field, matching the qualified v4 task; validate every positive quoted span against those exact bytes. The form remains method-blind.
pass_gate: Each pass must structurally validate and exactly match both frozen atomic labels, required-unit coverage, highest asserted level, limitation preservation, and false-premise handling. A failure is retained without retry or threshold change.
execution_gate: Run only from a normal network-enabled host after transport readiness reports READY_FOR_SCHEMA_CANARY; the managed shell is network-disabled.
